title: CallCenter AI Deployment
oneLiner: Containerized GPU-enabled ASR + embedding stack deployed to production on DigitalOcean.
objective: Deploy a call-center AI application on a DigitalOcean droplet by containerizing ASR and embedding models with GPU-enabled dependencies for reliable, scalable production inference.
achievements: Built a custom GPU-supported Python Docker image for ASR and embedding models.
Resolved dependency and runtime compatibility issues for stable GPU inference on DigitalOcean.
Deployed and validated end-to-end inference in production with reproducible, consistent performance.
